title: What does it really take to rank on page 1?
summary: I built a Wordpress website for my niche mortgage business and used Claude to help me with SEO and AEO. I started building and indexing pages with the help of ChatGPT about 7 months ago and then about 3 months ago I connected Claude Code to my webpage and it's been managing my site since then. Mostly just making sure all the plugins are updated and making site wide changes I ask it to. Here are some stats for the last 12 months and seems to be getting worse. Month Impressions Clicks CTR Avg Pos Nov 2025 139 9 6.47% 11.6 Dec 2025 462 3 0.65% 5.4 Jan 2026 376 10 2.66% 7.0 Feb 2026 2,333 14 0.60% 25.0 Mar 2026 5,911 22 0.37% 31.6 Apr 2026 4,951 15 0.30% 32.1 May 2026 3,453 8 0.23% 43.0 Jun 2026 4,218 15 0.36% 44.2 Jul 2026 11,859 19 0.16% 51.0 Aug 2026 11,138 9 0.08% 59.7 Sep 2026 3,488 6 0.17% 49.6 February/March is when I added 31 pages and ran FB ads. June is when I connected Claude Code and got rid of some low performing pages. Here's just the high level stuff Claude has done or helped me do. Full technical audit + cleanup — fixed canonicals, broken links, sitemap, redirects Merged thin/duplicate pages into stronger hub pages (301 + noindex) Rewrote every title/meta; made each location page unique (no templated content) Added server-side schema (FAQ, LocalBusiness, Org/Person, reviews) so Google and AI can actually read it AEO work: entity + E-E-A-T signals, structured FAQs, llms.txt for AI answer engines Local SEO: optimized Google Business Profile, fixed citations/NAP across directories Off-site push: directories, reviews, and digital PR for backlinks Weekly GSC/GA4 tracking, plus monitoring AI-assistant referral traffic I've been getting a solid amount of leads from LLMs which is awesome but I feel like my business would explode if I could start ranking on page 1. So what does it take to rank on page 1? /u/ActionWins
